title: Constrained Probabilistic Numerics: Gaussian Process Solvers for Linear PDEs under Linear Inequality Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.13804v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaussian process solvers for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) return posteriors rather than point estimates, but they condition only on equality information: the PDE residual, boundary data, and measurements. Many solutions of interest also obey inequality constraints, including nonnegativity, monotonicity, and absence of arbitrage, which equality conditioning cannot enforce. We prove that conditioning a Gaussian process prior jointly on linear equality observations and a finite-dimensional inequality event is equivalent to conditioning sequentially in terms of Borel measures on the solution space. The physics-informed posterior is therefore a valid prior for the inequality update at virtual points. The combined law is non-Gaussian yet computable through truncated-Gaussian moments, and neither the PDE conditioning nor the inequality update requires modification. translated_title: 约束概率数值方法：线性不等式约束下线性偏微分方程的高斯过程求解器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13804v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：线性偏微分方程（PDE）的高斯过程求解器返回的是后验分布而非点估计，但它们仅以等式信息为条件：PDE残差、边界数据和测量值。然而，许多感兴趣的解还满足不等式约束，包括非负性、单调性和无套利性，而这些约束无法通过等式条件来强制执行。我们证明，将高斯过程先验同时条件于线性等式观测和一个有限维不等式事件，等价于在解空间上以Borel测度的形式进行顺序条件化。因此，融合物理信息的后验可以被视为虚拟点处不等式更新的有效先验。组合后的分布虽然是非高斯的，但可以通过截断高斯矩进行计算，且PDE条件化和不等式更新均无需任何修改。我们在一个泊松基准问题、期权定价……上对该构造方法进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种支持线性不等式约束（如非负性、单调性）的高斯过程PDE求解方法，证明等式与不等式条件化可以顺序进行，并通过截断高斯矩实现了非高斯后验的可计算性。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Gaussian process solvers for linear PDEs to enforce linear inequality constraints (e.g., nonnegativity and monotonicity), proving that equality and inequality conditioning can be applied sequentially and yielding a computable non-Gaussian posterior via truncated-Gaussian moments.
